newsitem.title: USA: Jabil Circuit names new financial chief.
newsitem.headline: Jabil Circuit names new financial chief.

text.p: Jabil Circuit Inc Thursday said two key management executives have been promoted.
It said Ronald Rapp has been promoted to executive vice president of operations and Chris Lewis has been named to replace him as chief financial officer. The changes are effective immediately.

Rapp had served as Jabil's Chief Financial Officer and Director since 1989. As executive vice president of operations, he will oversee long term development of advanced technology efforts, organizational structure, personnel development and information systems. He will additionally take responsibility for integration of new plant locations resulting from greenfield developments or acquisitions.
Lewis joined Jabil Circuit in 1995 as treasurer.
